answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it explicitly reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, though duration and margin effects are omitted. Memory 44 directly supports qualified pipeline quality through sales-assisted enterprise conversion, but lacks closed-won, retention, and revenue-duration evidence. Memories 31 and 86 show durable activation/adoption improvements, plausible leading indicators of sustainable revenue, but do not report qualification, monetization, retention, or margin. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift for price-sensitive SMBs, but promotional pricing leaves margin, durability, and post-promotion retention unaddressed. Memory 91 reports only week-one engagement and first meaningful action, with no demonstrated downstream revenue, qualification, retention, or durability.
